preconditions.description: The number of employees n must be between 1 and 3000.
The maximum salary D must be between 1 and 10^9.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= p_i <= i for i in range(2, n+1))
preconditions.description: Each employee's direct superior must be a valid employee number.

postconditions.description: The output must be the number of ways to assign salaries modulo 10^9 + 7.
